meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files

howto.what: 当你问起 Codex Rules,它会依据原文说明:规则在会话开始与用户发言时注入静态说明,apply_patch 后按文件匹配注入;动态输出去重且不改写工具输出。还会列出项目规则来源与环境变量。
howto.when: 当用户问起 Codex Rules 的行为、支持的规则文件位置或环境配置时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 何时注入规则?
规则文件可以放在哪些位置?
怎么用环境变量控制 Codex Rules?

howto.what_en: When asked, explains per the doc: static project rules are injected at session start and user prompt; file-matched rules after apply_patch. Dynamic output is deduped per session; tool output unchanged. Lists supported rule sources and env knobs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, supported rule-file locations, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: When does Codex Rules inject rules?
Where can I place rule files?
How do I configure Codex Rules via env vars?
